name: io.github.lahma/claude-roslyn-lsp
description: C# refactoring over MCP, backed by Microsoft's Roslyn language server: semantic rename, code actions, fix-all, formatting, symbol lookup and design-time diagnostics.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_SOLUTION
environmentVariables.description: Path to the .slnx, .sln or .csproj to load. Optional: the adapter discovers one from the working directory, honouring .vscode/settings.json's dotnet.defaultSolution. Set it in a monorepo, where discovery picks a solution that is often not the one being worked in. A path that does not exist is a startup failure rather than a fall back to discovery.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_ROSLYN_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Directory holding an already-installed Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.LanguageServer.dll, used instead of downloading one. Optional; set it to run air-gapped or against a locally built server. Its version is not checked. Alias: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_SERVER_PATH.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_ROSLYN_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the pinned roslyn-language-server version the adapter downloads from nuget.org. Optional; the pin is the only version this release is tested against, an override has no hash to verify against, and doctor reports it as unverified. Alias: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_SERVER_VERSION.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_ROSLYN_ARGS
environmentVariables.description: Extra arguments for the Roslyn child process, split on whitespace with no quoting. Development only: it exists so the smoke test can point the launcher at this binary's own scripted backend.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where downloaded Roslyn servers are extracted. Optional; defaults to a directory under the adapter's home. Moves the payloads only - logs and staged downloads stay under the home.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_HOME
environmentVariables.description: The adapter's per-user state directory: downloads, logs and lock files. Optional; unset, it falls back to CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA and then to the platform cache location (%LOCALAPPDATA%, ~/Library/Caches, $XDG_CACHE_HOME or ~/.cache). Around 140 MB extracted per Roslyn version per platform, so it belongs on a disk with room and outside a roaming profile.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to refuse to download a Roslyn server. A missing cache entry becomes an immediate, explained failure instead of a 70 MB fetch. Accepts 1/true/yes/on and 0/false/no/off; default 0.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: How the adapter talks to the Roslyn child process: pipe (default) or stdio. The named pipe is preferred because Roslyn writes a startup banner to its own stdout, which under stdio shares a stream with the protocol.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: How long a call waits for the workspace to finish loading before it is answered anyway, 1-3600, default 120. Tools report status "loading" rather than hanging while they wait.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_DIAGNOSTICS
environmentVariables.description: The pull-to-push diagnostics bridge, on by default. Applies to the lsp verb only: an MCP client asks for diagnostics with getDiagnostics instead. Accepts 1/true/yes/on and 0/false/no/off.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_DIAGNOSTIC_MIN_SEVERITY
environmentVariables.description: The severity floor applied before diagnostics are pushed to an LSP client: error, warning (default), information or hint. The MCP getDiagnostics tool takes its own minSeverity argument instead.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_WORKSPACE_DIAGNOSTICS
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in workspace-wide diagnostics for files that are not open, for the lsp verb. Off unless set, because it needs a full-solution compiler scope, which is what makes a large solution slow.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_FILE_WATCHER
environmentVariables.description: The file-watch bridge, on by default. Without it a file created by a shell command or by git never joins its project and every later answer is silently stale. Accepts 1/true/yes/on and 0/false/no/off.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_GC
environmentVariables.description: Which garbage collector the Roslyn child runs with: workstation (the default) or server. Workstation peaks at about 577 MB on a 239-project solution where server peaks at about 2 GB, and costs about 8 seconds of load time. An explicit DOTNET_gcServer in the environment wins over this.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Critical or None (default Information). Logs go to stderr only - stdout is the JSON-RPC channel.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_ROSLYN_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: The level handed to the Roslyn child process, default Warning. Its Information level is about twenty lines of narration per start, all of it on this adapter's stderr.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_OPTIONS
environmentVariables.description: A JSON object merged into the answers the adapter gives Roslyn's workspace/configuration requests, for the sections the defaults get wrong for your repository. A syntax error is a logged warning, never a startup failure.
